fill: steps.json.steps: complete step sequence per data.task; every step gets id/name/output/depends_on/op_ref/mind_ref/acceptance_criteria/status=pending

op-table.json.operations: define only ops actually referenced by steps; reuse template ops (op-query/op-generate/op-verify/op-materialize) when they fit; declare required_skills/required_mcp when an op needs an external capability
minds.json.minds: define minds referenced by steps; reference existing mind params (mind-default/mind-audit) when they fit
rules: steps must be atomic: each step independently verifiable with a concrete artifact and mechanical acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria must be mechanically checkable: file exists / field non-empty / count threshold / format compliance; never 'looks reasonable' or 'verify quality'
coupling hotspots must become step boundaries: where errors propagate densely (shared mutable code, cross-system API friction), split into separate steps with materialized handoff
granularity calibrated by error-propagation radius: too coarse leaves hidden chains inside a step; too fine explodes step count and overhead
minimize depends_on: parallel-first, independent steps must not be serialized
reuse ops: do not create new operations when existing ones suffice; keep op vocabulary convergent
failure containment: a step's failure must affect only that step, not propagate downstream
mind matching: exploration/audit steps use mind-audit; mechanical execution steps use mind-default; reuse existing mind-params instead of inventing new ones

capability slots: when an op needs an external skill or MCP tool, declare it on the op (required_skills / required_mcp, non-empty-string arrays; empty = none); a step may add step-level extras (extra_skills / extra_mcp) on top of its op; these slots are injected into the T3 dispatch so the executor assembles them directly instead of discovering them

data.template_ref: <optional: existing three-piece skeleton from templates/ or examples/>
data.intel_ref: <optional: step1 intelligence artifact path, e.g. artifacts/step1_intel.json>

forbidden: do not invent op_ref or mind_ref not defined in the corresponding tables
do not set status to anything other than pending
do not write prose explanations outside the JSON artifacts
do not skip output.file: every step must materialize an artifact
